assessment: Exclusive mkdir rejects an existing directory before any permission mutation. O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW opens only the new public directory, and fchmod(0755) is not masked by inherited umask077. Descriptor is closed even when chmod/fsync fails.

Only fixed public NATIVE_ROOT permission changes. Private directories, capability journal, immutable binary size/hash gate, capture/binary modes, DynamicUser isolation, limits, one-shot intent and both shutdown controls remain unchanged.
Permission/open/fsync failure stops before download or unit start, records only finite failure classification, and reaches unconditional native_shutdown even if receipt persistence/publication fails.

Three new tests exercise the actual embedded host function with labelled external-service doubles: real filesystem modes at the download boundary, collision preserving existing directory/sentinel, and chmod failure with no download/unit plus shutdown and no exception-string disclosure. Existing tests remain.
